capabilities: List open editor tabs in an independent sidebar panel
Filter tabs by title via search or a command
Switch between vertical list, card, and masonry layouts with sorting and display options
Show only the active tab group in the main workspace via single-pane mode
disambiguation: Not a file explorer, workspace manager, or project navigation system; it only manages tabs that are already open in the editor area.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README warns it is built primarily for the author's personal workflow, may contain bugs or regressions, and encourages users to fork it for custom behavior. Documentation is provided in English and Chinese.
problem: Obsidian lacks a lightweight, low-overhead panel that shows all open editor tabs in one place for fast switching and simple visual organization.
summary: Sidebar panel that lists the editor's open tabs with list, card, or masonry layouts, title filtering, and drag reordering.
